{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
    -- Find the product_id for BK-T79U-54
    SELECT 
        p.product_id as assembly_id,
        p.product_id as root_product_id,
        1.0 as total_qty
    FROM product p
    WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-T79U-54'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode BOM
    SELECT 
        bom.component_id as assembly_id,
        bt.root_product_id,
        bt.total_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty as total_qty
    FROM bom_tree bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bt.assembly_id = bom.assembly_id
    JOIN product p ON bom.component_id = p.product_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT 
    p.product_number,
    p.name,
    SUM(bt.total_qty) as total_quantity_needed
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN product p ON bt.assembly_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'BE-2908'
GROUP BY p.product_number, p.name"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (

    b.per_assembly_qty

  WHERE p.product_number = 'TO-2301'
    AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursively find assemblies that contain those assemblies
  SELECT 
    b.assembly_id,
    bt.assembly_id AS component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty * bt.per_assembly_qty
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.component_id = bt.assembly_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
)
-- Count distinct top-level products (where assembly_id IS NULL means it's a header, but we need to trace to top)
-- Actually, we need to find all products that have TO-2301 anywhere in their BOM
-- The assembly_id in our CTE represents the parent; we need to find the ultimate top-level product
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT final_products.product_id) AS product_count
FROM (
  -- Direct assemblies containing TO-2301
  SELECT assembly_id AS product_id FROM bom_tree WHERE assembly_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  -- Also need to trace up to top-level products. 
  -- If an assembly is itself a component of another, we need to keep going up.
  -- Let's rebuild: find all paths from top-level products down to TO-2301
  SELECT DISTINCT top_level FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE bom_up AS (
      -- Start from TO-2301 and go up
      SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        CASE WHEN b.assembly_id IS NULL THEN b.component_id ELSE b.assembly_id END as current_id
      FROM bill_of_materials b
      JOIN product p ON b.component_id = p.product_id
      WHERE p.product_number = 'TO-2301'
        AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
      
      UNION ALL
      
      SELECT 
        b.assembly_id,
        bu.current_id,
        CASE WHEN b.assembly_id IS NULL THEN b.component_id ELSE b.assembly_id END
      FROM bill_of_materials b
      JOIN bom_up bu ON b.component_id = bu.current_id
      WHERE b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
        AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= '2025-06-30')
    )
    SELECT current_id AS top_level FROM bom_up
  ) t
) final_products"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_expand AS (
  SELECT sol.order_id, sol.order_date, sol.product_id AS root_product, sol.order_qty,
         bol.component_id, bol.per_assembly_qty AS qty_per_unit
  FROM sales_order_line sol
  JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
  JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
  JOIN bill_of_materials bol ON bol.assembly_id = sol.product_id
  WHERE st.name = 'Central' AND sol.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND sol.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND bol.start_date <= sol.order_date AND (bol.end_date IS NULL OR sol.order_date <= bol.end_date)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT be.order_id, be.order_date, be.root_product, be.order_qty,
         bol.component_id, be.qty_per_unit * bol.per_assembly_qty
  FROM bom_expand be
  JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id AND p.make_flag = true
  JOIN bill_of_materials bol ON bol.assembly_id = be.component_id
  WHERE bol.start_date <= be.order_date AND (bol.end_date IS NULL OR be.order_date <= bol.end_date)
),
part AS (SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348')
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sol.order_qty),0)
   FROM sales_order_line sol
   JOIN sales_order so ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
   JOIN sales_territory st ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
   JOIN part ON part.product_id = sol.product_id
   WHERE st.name = 'Central' AND sol.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND sol.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01')
  +
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(be.order_qty * be.qty_per_unit),0)
   FROM bom_expand be JOIN part ON part.product_id = be.component_id)
  AS total_demand"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
  -- Find the product_id for 'RW-M762'
  SELECT 
    p.product_id as root_product_id,
    p.product_id as assembly_id,
    p.product_id as component_id,

    bom.assembly_id,

  JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
  -- Find the product_id for 'RW-M762'
  SELECT 
    p.product_id as root_product_id,
    p.product_id as assembly_id,
    p.product_id as component_id,
    CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) as cumulative_qty,
    0 as level
  FROM product p
  WHERE p.product_number = 'RW-M762'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursively explode BOM
  SELECT 
    be.root_product_id,
    bom.assembly_id,
    bom.component_id,
    CAST(be.cumulative_qty * bom.per_assembly_qty AS DOUBLE) as cumulative_qty,
    be.level + 1 as level
  FROM bom_explosion be
  JOIN product p ON be.component_id = p.product_id
  JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON p.product_id = bom.assembly_id
  WHERE p.make_flag = true
    AND bom.start_date <= DATE '2021-09-05'
    AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bom.end_date >= DATE '2021-09-05')

JOIN product p_component ON be.component_id = p_component.product_id

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
  -- Find product BK-R89B-44
  SELECT p.product_id 
  FROM product p 
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-R89B-44'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion for 2021-10-16
bom_2021 AS (
  -- Start with the top-level product
  SELECT 
    b.component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
    b.bom_level
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom_paths bp ON b.assembly_id = bp.product_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-10-16')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
  SELECT 
    b.component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty * parent.qty AS qty,
    b.bom_level
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom_2021 parent ON b.assembly_id = parent.component_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2021-10-16')
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion for current (2025-06-30)
bom_current AS (
  -- Start with the top-level product
  SELECT 
    b.component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
    b.bom_level
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom_paths bp ON b.assembly_id = bp.product_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into sub-assemblies
  SELECT 
    b.component_id,
    b.per_assembly_qty * parent.qty AS qty,
    b.bom_level
  FROM bill_of_materials b
  JOIN bom_current parent ON b.assembly_id = parent.component_id
  WHERE b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' 
    AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
),
-- Get part MS-0253
part_ms AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-0253'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM bom_current, part_ms WHERE component_id = part_ms.product_id) -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM bom_2021, part_ms WHERE component_id = part_ms.product_id) AS qty_change"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_exploded AS (
  -- Start with the product itself as level 0
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_number,
    CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty_per_unit,
    0 AS bom_level
  FROM product p
  WHERE p.product_number = 'BK-M18S-44'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursively add components
  SELECT 
    c.component_id AS product_id,
    cp.product_number,
    e.total_qty_per_unit * c.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty_per_unit,
    c.bom_level
  FROM bom_exploded e
  JOIN bill_of_materials c ON e.product_id = c.assembly_id
  JOIN product cp ON c.component_id = cp.product_id
  WHERE c.start_date <= DATE '2021-08-10' 
    AND (c.end_date IS NULL OR c.end_date >= DATE '2021-08-10')
)
SELECT product_id, product_number, total_qty_per_unit, bom_level
FROM bom_exploded
WHERE product_number = 'SH-4562'"}
